# WriteLine <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Streams](BlitzBasic-Streams)

</div>


```blitzbasic
WriteLine:Void stream:Int32, string:String
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `stream` | In | Int32 | required | The stream to write to. |
| `string` | In | String | required | The text to write. |

## Description

Writes text followed by a carriage return and a line feed. Read it back with [ReadLine](ReadLine).
